claims.text: Every module opens with a one-line docstring that says what the file is for and why it is shaped the way it is, rather than restating the code underneath it.
Nothing here catches an exception or validates its input: load returns a widget of size zero for a name it does not know, so failure is expressed as a default rather than as an error.

The package is laid out by role and not by feature: core holds the record type and imports nothing internal, io holds the one function that builds it, and the entry point is the only place the two meet.
Relative imports are used inside the package and absolute ones at the entry point, which keeps widget movable as a whole while leaving the console script readable on its own.
